#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.7.0-20260909.63+96d7f692"
  - revision: "96d7f692"
  - timestamp: "Wed Sep  9 22:45:23 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- Merge pull request #30 from The-Big-Mini/MiniStoreFork
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- bump version to 0.7.0
- bump version to v0.6.5
- fixes for tvOS compile issues
- fix-tvOS: our min ios is 15
- v0.6.4-freeze
- keep sources backup and restore wip to debug only
- update sidesign to latest
- fix maintenance manager to run after db init so that db states to be migrated are also taken care
- updated submodule to latest
- fix: ensure pairing reset is not tied to oda by mistake
- updated submodules and deps to latest
- updated submodules to latest
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/develop' into MiniStoreFork
- refine operation log summary
- fix a codesign issue where coderesource builder was incorrectly including ignored files
- fix: codesign progress was overflowing causign overall progress to backtrack - make codesign not report progress
- added support for switching between resigned .ipa vs .app based sendAFC, install to eval time vs storage + export resigned app is now resigned ipa export
- renamed zipApp to createIpa
- added back zipping and tested again, install times of .ipa vs .app bundle is so drastic where resigned sendApp for .ipa is 10s while .app is 60s for a 130MB ipa isntall.
- optimize: removed/merged duplicate steps of copy etc during pipeline start
- cleanup + fixes/optimization for download operation to do a move from tmp to cache instead of doing a copy +  more logging
- updated log tags
- transition from roxas + switch prefetch handlers to async + remove redundant queue based completion handlers in db manager + update to nuke 13
- updated submodule to latest
- fix minimuxer backend change not being reflected due to caching
- move appids edits into developer portal - so remove it from other places
- added profile customizations during edits
- added capability to create profiles manually if possible (paid accts) + show portal cert management
- split listed(fetched) profile vs full profile(downloaded)
- change naming to sidesign
- added swipe to delete for cert management
- fix: ensure auth doesn't gives back cached session and creates a session based on fresh otp always (if required - meaning it can be cached if otp wasnt expired)
- fix compile issues
- streamline auth a bit more - ensure dev portal proxy calls auto get the latest auth session
- maintenance - added force clearing of override ip coz localdevvpn 1.3.0 is out now
- cleanup profiles parsing
- ensure all developer portal access goes thru proxy + added pull to refresh for developer services screens
- rework: remove authContext in favor of AuthManager managing session, use signinOperation for all explicit sign in + cleanup
- streamline auth session acquire centralized using AuthManager(authOperation) and cleanup contexts
- more cleanup - keep signin flow strictly to settings screen only while auth flow to all else
- more cleanup - streamline auth vs signin + keep only required stuff in context
- rework: split auth vs signIn where auth session is resolved using xcode token, dsid while sign-in is full flow
- fix: maintenance - logout users
- run migration v2
- fix: make changing anisette toggle require a restart
- updated submodule to latest

apps.name: MiniStore
apps.subtitle: SideStore with UI upgrades and preloaded sources
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
